text: 64 teams in a knockout cup: five rounds and a final. Rounds 1 and 2: two pots, one with the Bundesliga and 2. text: Final table in 2026-27, as the FIGC's Federal Council decided on 26 May 2026 on the proposal of the Lega Calcio Serie A, departing for this season from art. 51 of the NOIF. If two teams finish level on points in first place, the title (Campione d'Italia) goes to the winner of a single play-off match at the home of the team better placed in the mini-table (classifica avulsa); if it is level after normal time, there is no extra time and penalties decide. Where more than two teams are level, and for all the other places in the table, the classifica avulsa decides in this order: a) points in the matches between the teams concerned, b) goal difference in those matches, c) goal difference over the whole championship, d) goals scored over the whole championship, e) drawing of lots. If a team that would play the play-off is a finalist in a UEFA competition, the classifica avulsa decides instead. The number of clubs, matches per club and points per win are not stated on any page of the organiser or the federation that could be read (see the Wikipedia row).

If more than two teams are level, the classifica avulsa picks the two; if one of them is a finalist in a UEFA competition, the classifica avulsa decides instead. text: 2026-27: the champion, if it meets the criteria and holds the licence for the 3. Liga, plays two promotion matches, home and away, against the champion of the Regionalliga Nord; these are DFB matches under DFB rules. As a rule the bottom two go down to the Bayernliga, and a club that does not apply for or does not get admission counts as relegated. The two clubs placed just above the best-placed relegated club play a relegation round against the relegation teams of the Bayernliga Nord and Süd: two legs, the Bayernliga club at home first; level after both, extra time of 2 x 15 minutes in the second leg, then penalties. A second round is played only if the league falls below or goes above its target of 18 clubs.
basis: published: the BFV's promotion and relegation rules for the Spieljahr 2026/2027, sections I to IV.

text: 18 teams as a rule (18 in 2026-27). Three points for a win, one for a draw. Level on points: goal difference, then goals scored; if still level where it matters, a deciding match on neutral ground, with extra time of 2 x 15 minutes for men.

text: As a rule the bottom three go down to the Oberligen of the four state associations; more go down if relegation from the 3. Liga takes the league above 18. Three teams come up as a rule: the Oberliga Niedersachsen champion directly, and the winner and runner-up of a promotion round between the champions of Hamburg, Bremen and Schleswig-Holstein and the runner-up of Niedersachsen. The champion, if admitted for the 3. Liga, takes part in the promotion matches to the 3. Liga, which the DFB organises; in 2026-27 it plays the champion of the Regionalliga Bayern home and away. Conflict for Alexandru: Wikipedia's 2026-27 article says the bottom two go down as a rule; the NFV's rules say three.
basis: published: NFV Spielordnung (Stand 19 March 2026) § 6; the NFV's league page (no season); the BFV's promotion rules for 2026/2027 and Wikipedia (de) for the 2026-27 opponent.
